sources.snippet: Ternary BitNet MoE 🧮 A 1GB mixture-of-experts AI that runs on an ordinary laptop — no GPU required. This project takes Microsoft's BitNet b1.58 2B-4T language model — whose weights are ternary, meaning every weight is just -1, 0, or +1 — and turns it into a tiny mixture-of-experts system:

sources.title: Bitnet Ternary MoE GGUF | Sweet Tea Studio
sources.snippet: bitnet-ternary-moe-gguf 🧮 A 1GB Mixture-of-Experts model designed to run efficiently on an everyday laptop CPU, with no GPU needed. A single 1.58-bit BitNet base model with two lightweight LoRA expert adapters (multiplication and Roman numerals) that are dynamically activated at runtime by an external router.
